persistence_modes.default_mode: BROWSER_ONLY (no database required): localStorage KVStore; IndexedDB DocumentStore, RuntimeStore, asset store (registry + blobs), atomic asset registry
persistence_modes.optional_http: Embedded persistence HTTP server /api/persistence (no standalone service); HttpKVStore/HttpDocumentStore/etc. clients; NEXT_PUBLIC_PERSISTENCE build-time switch + PERSISTENCE_DEV_TOKEN / NEXT_PUBLIC_PERSISTENCE_TOKEN (development auth; production requires real server-auth)
persistence_modes.optional_postgres: PostgreSQL-backed documents, learner runtime, assets, durable agent sessions, session materials, user skills via @openmaic/storage server backends; docker compose --profile server-persistence (app + Postgres); DATABASE_URL required only for server persistence or agent runtime
persistence_modes.optional_s3: Server asset byte layer pluggable: PostgreSQL byte column or S3 (@aws-sdk/client-s3 + s3-request-presigner; signable S3 URLs OR redirect egress)
persistence_modes.durable_agent_sessions: server-backed by design: OPENMAIC_AGENT_RUNTIME_ENABLED=true + DATABASE_URL; sessions DB-backed with leases, heartbeats, crash resume, cancellation, follow-up steering; browser-only default does NOT provide durable workbench sessions
persistence_modes.claim_verification: CONFIRMED: default runtime can operate without PostgreSQL using browser storage (README 'OpenMAIC runs without a database by default ... use browser storage'; @openmaic/storage README 'zero-server clone-and-run default'). Nuance: the v1.0.0 agent workbench durable-session feature is opt-in and PostgreSQL-backed.

authority_boundary.no_second_authority: OpenMAIC internal multi-agent classroom MUST NOT become P2P orchestration or review authority; its artifacts entering P2P are normalized through existing BackendExecutionBridge/ReturnPacket

security_static_assessment.scope: bounded static review only; no penetration test
security_static_assessment.secrets: server-side provider config only; credentials never reach browser; server-providers.yml and .env* gitignored (only .env.example tracked); no committed API keys found in tracked files; ACCESS_CODE optional HMAC-signed cookie auth
network_calls: web fetch/search surface gated: origin allow-list from session/user context; strict-fetch path with SSRF guard

SSRF controls CONFIRMED: lib/server/ssrf-guard.ts (hostname + DNS-resolution IP classification, IPv4/IPv6/mapped-v6, private/link-local/loopback rejection), pinned connection-time DNS via undici Agent lookup, redirect-safe; ALLOW_LOCAL_NETWORKS=true is an explicit weakener for self-hosted deployments
bounded downloads: response + aggregate byte budgets (e.g., remote images 20MB/100MB, web fetch default 5MB, classroom media 100MB), timeouts
render-service URL deliberately bypasses SSRF guard only when operator explicitly configures it (documented)
uploaded_document_handling: MIME registry + normalization (lib/document/mime.ts); unsupported/aliased types rejected
extraction pipeline (UnPDF/MinerU/AliDocMind/local ffmpeg) with provider capability checks; server-side extraction records with lease fencing
size bounds: agent upload default 50MB (OPENMAIC_AGENT_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES), video export capped 300MB stream, VoxCPM voice clone 10MB
generated_html_interactive_execution: generated interactive HTML/simulation scenes run in the learner's browser; exported HTML is self-contained and inlines third-party libs as data URIs
P2P boundary: treat vendor-generated HTML as untrusted rendered content; containment/sandboxing review belongs to execution-registration gate, not intake
security_static_assessment.web_fetch_search_surfaces: web_search provider config server-side; fetch-url honored origin allow-list; content-type allow-list (text/html, text/plain, application/pdf, xhtml); readable extraction (readability/turndown/linkedom); results marked trusted/untrusted
security_static_assessment.local_provider_execution: Ollama/Lemonade/FunASR/VoxCPM2/ComfyUI/MinerU/SearXNG are operator-run services on operator-controlled hosts; OpenMAIC is a client, not a sandbox host
security_static_assessment.server_side_persistence: optional PostgreSQL/S3 with per-scope KV (device values never leave device), content-hash asset registry, sign-only S3 URLs or redirect egress; dev tokens must be replaced by real auth in production (documented)
security_static_assessment.file_export_import: PPTX/HTML/ZIP export client- or server-side; classroom ZIP import validated; offline inlining attempts all referenced assets at export time and reports failures
security_static_assessment.dependency_install_footprint: root: 130 direct deps (+ 32 dev) incl. Next.js 16, React 19, LangGraph, Vercel AI SDK, CopilotKit, ProseMirror, sharp, docx/pdf-lib/jszip/katex; pnpm-lock 1.04MB; ignoredBuiltDependencies sharp/unrs-resolver; postinstall builds all workspace packages (no network beyond registry)
security_static_assessment.headers: CSP frame-ancestors 'self' (+optional ALLOWED_FRAME_ANCESTORS), X-Frame-Options SAMEORIGIN when no custom ancestors
